verse.verse_1: When the sky is cleft asunder;
verse.verse_2: and when the stars are scattered;
verse.verse_4: and when the graves are laid open:
verse.verse_5: then everyone will know what he has sent ahead, and what he has left behind.
verse.verse_6: O man! What is it that lures you away from your bountiful Sustainer,
verse.verse_7: who created you, fashioned you and proportioned you,
verse.verse_9: Yet you deny the Last Judgement.
verse.verse_10: Surely, there are guardians watching over you,
verse.verse_12: who know all that you do:
verse.verse_13: the virtuous will dwell in bliss,
verse.verse_14: whereas the wicked will be in Hell;
verse.verse_15: which they shall enter on the Day of Judgement,
verse.verse_16: and from which they will find no escape.
verse.verse_17: What will make you realize what the Day of Judgement will be?
verse.verse_18: Again: what will make you realize what the Day of Judgement will be?
verse.verse_19: It will be a Day when no human being shall be of the least avail to any other human being, God [alone] will hold command on that Day.
